topic: The Transformational View of Derivatives: From Slopes to Sensitivities

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Velocity Analogy
lecture_lines: Velocity: From total distance to exact instant.
Imagine a cheetah lunging at a gazelle.
We measure speed at that precise point.
Average speed becomes instantaneous speed.
Calculus reveals the truth of the moment.
animations: Fade in 'Velocity Gauge' graphic at center (#FFFFFF).

Transition 'Velocity Gauge' to a position curve graph (#33FF57).

Scale up the slope visualization for clarity (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Prerequisite Visual: The Secant-to-Tangent Transition
lecture_lines: Consider a simple curve.
Draw a secant line between two points.
Slide the second point toward the first.
The secant converges to a tangent line.
This line defines our instantaneous slope.
animations: Appear 'Secant Line' connecting two points on a curve (#FFFFFF).
Morph 'Secant Line' as the points draw closer (#FF5733).
Show 'Tangent Line' emerging as the limit (#33FF57).
Label 'Secant' and 'Tangent' with contrasting colors (#F3FF33, #FFFFFF).
Animate transition cycle between secant and tangent states (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Core Concept: The Derivative as a Local Linear Transformer
lecture_lines: Derivatives are local linear transformers.
Magnify a curve to see a line.
The derivative is the local magnification factor.
It translates input variations to output changes.
Linear approximation defines the derivative.
animations: Display linear transformation matrix acting on a vector (#FFFFFF).
Animate vector rotating and scaling (#FF5733).
Show 'Derivative' as the local Jacobian matrix (#33FF57).
Overlay local grid distortion to show linearity (#F3FF33).
Fade in label 'Local Linear Map' (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Visualizing Sensitivity: The 'What-If' Machine
lecture_lines: The derivative is a sensitivity gauge.
It amplifies or shrinks input nudges.
Small input change leads to output shift.
animations: Display function input 'x' and output 'f(x)' (#FFFFFF).
Animate 'x' shifting slightly, observing 'f(x)' change (#FF5733).
Show 'Sensitivity' via slope of the change (#33FF57).

sections.title: Summary & Synthesis
lecture_lines: Derivatives reveal linear truth in curves.
We turn dynamic change into static ratios.
Zooming in makes complexity manageable.
animations: Display summary table of derivative concepts (#FFFFFF).
Animate connecting lines between 'Velocity', 'Tangent', and 'Linearity' (#FF5733).
Flash the synthesized conclusion 'Derivative = Local Sensitivity' (#33FF57).
